question: In the RSC Advances study of biochar loading in dual-phase MIL-100(Al)/MIL-110(Al) hybrids for CO2 adsorption, what residual mass did BC-10 and BC-0 leave at 800 °C in the TGA under nitrogen?
rendered: According to the excerpt from page 9 of the paper "Biochar loading modulates pore accessibility and CO2 adsorption in dual-phase MIL-100(Al)/MIL-110(Al) hybrids", BC-10 retained approximately 47 wt% of its initial mass at 800 °C. BC-0 retained approximately 21 wt% of its initial mass at 800 °C.
